checks.message: Provisional boundary is present; replace with official redline before professional scoring.
Three required key areas are provisional; replace with official polygons before professional scoring.
Initial land-use polygons are derived from site boundary partitioning.
Static HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, and assumptions.

Reviewer (wakenmeng) CHANGES_REQUESTED 反馈已系统性处理:visual/index.html 5 张 img src 模板变量已替换为相对路径;report/proposal.html 2 处 HTML 注释泄漏已剥离;metrics.json site_area_sqm confidence 由 high 降为 medium 并加 provisional_dependency / boundary_status / dependency_note_zh 显式标注;sources.json 7 条原 source 补齐 rights/license/access_date/provenance/verified_by,新增 9 条产出登记(5 PNG + 2 PDF + 2 HTML);5 张 PNG 主图与 2 个 PDF 用 NotoSansCJK 重绘,无字体回退;manifest.json 30 个文件 SHA-256 已重新计算。
HTML 离线约束已校验:no CDN, no remote map tile, no external script, no iframe, no form, no API call, no tracking code. 5 张图路径已修正为 ../assets/figures/*.png 相对路径,Markdown 注释泄漏已剥离。

所有派生自 provisional polygon 的指标 (site_area_sqm / building_footprint_area_sqm / green_ratio / public_space_ratio / key_area_count) 已加 provisional_dependency=true,boundary_status=provisional,dependency_note_zh 显式说明复算要求,confidence 已统一为 medium。
7 条原 source 全部补 rights/license/access_date/provenance/verified_by;新增 9 条产出登记(5 PNG + 2 PDF + 2 HTML) 全部标 CC0-1.0 self-authored + 字体来源 + 重建原因。
5 张 PNG 主图与 2 个 PDF 用 NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc 重新生成,无字体回退 (no tofu boxes),标签无重叠,内容不超出画布,无大面积无效留白。
